title: penducella cordilabia
intro: Penducella cordilabia, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and enhancing antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Indian pennywort include its ability to modulate the nervous system, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
